method: Public web text retrieval; first-party source reading and linked example descriptions. No external screenshot critique, live tasks, paired builds or participant tests.
rights: Only links and original notes bundled. No external media or fonts copied. Verify exact release licenses and artwork rights separately before reuse.

records.author: Rasmus Andersson
facts: Describes text and display optical-size designs.
Lists tabular figures and slashed zero as OpenType features.
Links SIL Open Font License 1.1.
records.inference: Choose optical role and numeric features for actual task specimens.
records.limits: Author claims; glyph readability and selected file license not independently tested.

records.author: IBM Design
facts: Documents sans, serif, mono and condensed subfamilies.
Shows OpenType features and discusses Latin/non-Latin coverage.
records.inference: Use related families deliberately and verify exact target-script metrics.
records.limits: No font file imported or shaping test executed.

records.author: IBM Design
facts: Relates sizes to line heights.
Documents adjusted sizing for specified scripts in IBM's system.
records.inference: Script-aware line metrics matter; do not copy brand-specific adjustments universally.
records.limits: Not a general comparative type-readability study.

records.author: Arrow Type / Recursive project
facts: Describes Monospace, Casual, Weight, Slant and Cursive axes.
Describes related sans/mono roles and stable widths across several axes.
records.inference: Related roles can differ while keeping system coherence.
records.limits: Controls and font rendering were not exercised; selected distribution license must be checked.

records.author: Google Fonts / project contributors
facts: Repository identifies an OFL-1.1 license.
Distinguishes main-branch development download from releases.
records.inference: Pin and verify a selected release rather than silently consuming development files.
records.limits: No binary inspection or compatibility test; repo license does not license unrelated artwork.

records.author: Microsoft Fluent
facts: Defines semantic ramps with different platform stacks.
Discusses casing, alignment and hierarchy.
records.limits: No evidence that a single Fluent ramp fits every subject.

records.author: Russell Samora
facts: Discusses preserving scroll narrative versus stacking charts on mobile.
Links actual examples and considers meaning/performance tradeoffs.
records.inference: Preserve the explanatory relationship rather than the desktop effect.
records.limits: Historical implementation details; linked experiences not executed.

records.author: Pentagram; Public Theater identity project
records.publishedDate: not established; account describes work since 1994
facts: Connects active street typography to the theater mission and city.
Describes wood-type posters around a tap artist and later structural refinement.
records.inference: Derive type composition from subject/context rather than applying a fashionable face.
records.limits: Text and image descriptions read; no external images downloaded or outcomes measured.

records.author: GOV.UK Design community
facts: Requires research evidence when patterns need adaptation.
Restricts non-GOV.UK use of its identity, GDS Transport and brand colors.
records.inference: Reuse suitable interaction knowledge without copying protected identity.
records.limits: Government context; not a prescription for all visual expression.

records.author: IBM Design
facts: Discusses perspective, framing, focal points and aspect ratios.
Describes eye-level/aerial preference and avoids conflicting focal points.
records.inference: Specify consistent viewpoint and a clear focal subject; brand-specific preferences stay local.
records.limits: Image descriptions/guidance only; no photo quality or crop experiment.

records.author: IBM Carbon Design System
records.publishedDate: not established; page labels guidance work in progress
facts: Separates categorical, sequential, diverging and alert palettes.
Describes ordinal magnitude and category-differentiation roles.
records.inference: Choose chart color by data meaning; preserve non-color labels.
records.limits: Brand palette examples do not certify our combinations or charts.

records.author: Microsoft Xbox Accessibility
facts: Considers size, face, weight, spacing, alignment, case and color.
Discusses player configuration and rendered-text measurement.
records.inference: Test actual glyph height and viewing conditions, not CSS numbers alone.
records.limits: No game runtime, controller or low-vision participant test.

records.author: Duolingo team; individual byline not established in retrieved content
facts: Describes guided lesson path and contextual lesson information.
Explains rearrangement of existing content and practice.
records.inference: Task sequencing can supply the organizing visual device.
records.limits: Historical author explanation, not current app or independent efficacy evidence.

records.author: Vitsœ; Dieter Rams principles
records.publishedDate: not established; describes principles originating in late 1970s
facts: Presents usefulness, comprehension and aesthetics as connected principles.
Illustrates principles with named physical products.
records.inference: Review craft as part of use and truthful product explanation.
records.limits: Philosophy with examples; not causal evidence or an interface experiment.

comparisonProtocol: Review new local showcases before builder rationales; record anonymous code, viewport, screenshot path, first impression, actionable faults and task observations. Reveal surface/identity afterward. Different briefs are not a controlled A/B comparison.
